entry.name: keyPath
entry.label: Path to the file that contains the NaN API key.

entry.name: panelModel
entry.label: Model reflected in the panel: worst, max or fixed.

entry.name: panelModelId
entry.label: Model id used when panelModel is fixed.

entry.name: panelGauge
entry.label: Gauge style in the panel: ring, bar or none.

entry.name: showIcon
entry.label: Show the NaN icon in the panel.

entry.name: showPercentage
entry.label: Show the utilization percentage in the panel.

entry.name: showReset
entry.label: Show the time until reset in the panel.

entry.name: hideUnused
entry.label: Hide models with zero usage in the popup.

entry.name: showMetrics
entry.label: Show aggregated usage (24 h, month, 30 days) in the popup.
